Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
Political Struggle says

"If the vampire with this card is burned or sent into
torpor, the acting vampire gains X votes, where X is
the number of non-contested votes the vampire with this
card has; burn this card afterwards."

Does the Struggle-playing vampire "gain" the votes *from*
the Struggle-targeted vampire? The way it's written, it
sounds like the votes are created by the Struggle itself,
and both the "victim" and the Struggler will have X votes,
if the victim comes back out of torpor after the Struggler
gains the votes. But I wanted to make sure...

Josh

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Messages.Author: Pat Ricochet
Messages.Body:


You can continue to drop more Struggles and keep yo-yo-ing
the guy in and out of torpor, piling up votes, yes.
Note that with Regent, you can drop the card on a guy, call
Political Struggle on him, rush him, torporize and Amaranth,
gaining 4 votes from the Struggle for burning the vampire, and
the move the Regent card (before the bloodhunt, per card text)
for 4 MORE votes, giving *8* votes to the guy who had none at
the start of the turn, likely able to shut down the Blood Hunt/
Wyld Hunt all his own.
Now if only I had more than one Regent. . .

--
Pat Ricochet
Soul Jar'rn Fool of Atlanta
